readings: Group the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots by announcement timing (`eventannotm`), treating a missing timing as its own group, and compute each group's average institutional ownership (`instownpct`), ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the simple average of these group averages, each timing group counting equally. For the groups whose average is strictly above that baseline, give in one row the mean of their averages and the mean amount by which they exceed the baseline, without rounding.
queries:
WITH timing_averages AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ownership) AS baseline_ownership
  FROM timing_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_group_average,
  AVG(t.avg_ownership - b.baseline_ownership) AS mean_excess
FROM timing_averages AS t
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE t.avg_ownership > b.baseline_ownership
